'''Gaia''' is the fictional world used as the setting of [[Jane Pensworth]]'s [[A Wild World]] book series.

== Role In A Wild World ==

Source material says ''A Wild World'' is set in Gaia, beginning in 1021 and ranging across thousands of years of fictional history. The surviving [[A Wild World: Book 1]] source fragment describes a much earlier era involving elves, dragons, magic, high technology, and a catastrophic war.

== Canon Limits ==

Gaia is not treated as an Avant continent, country, planet, or historical region. It is a literary setting inside [[Solaran Literature]]. This distinction keeps Pensworth's fantasy material available for cultural lore without retconning Avant political history.
